blocker_reason: MAINTAINER DECISION owed, twice over. (1) ORDERING: does the real frame always go first, conceding R-U3-2's unpredictability? Recommended yes — it makes all four P1s structural rather than guarded — and the concession is cheap: order randomness defends against neither the hostile relay (which reads recipient_id in cleartext on both envelopes) nor the passive observer (two equal-length opaque frames, same send event either way); it buys only 5-50 ms of ambiguity for an observer watching both ends. (2) RATE BUDGET: cover doubles message.send volume against a per-account limit the client cannot see, and rate_limited carries no message id while onServerError is a no-op, so a real send lost to it sits in SENDING forever. Closes only with a relay-side change (exempt/raise the budget, or carry the message id). See reviews/decoy-0.10.0/u3-fix-r1-ordering-decision.md.
